items.title: Industry letter urges Washington against open-weights restrictions — 25 signatories, OpenAI/Anthropic/Google absent
key_facts: 25 co-signatories including NVIDIA, Microsoft, Meta, IBM, Dell, Palantir, Hugging Face, Mozilla, Linux Foundation, Mistral, a16z, Y Combinator, Replit, CrowdStrike, ServiceNow, Perplexity
OpenAI, Anthropic, Google did not sign
Jensen Huang X post drew 11M+ views
Letter argues distillation is natural development, not misappropriation
caveats: PDF binary unreadable via WebFetch; signatory list verified through TechCrunch and The Next Web
Jensen Huang X view count sourced from secondary social aggregators

items.title: Claude Opus 5 ships with 1M context, mid-conversation tool changes beta
key_facts: Pricing: $5 input / $25 output per million tokens

Extended thinking on by default
Beta: mid-conversation-tool-changes-2026-07-01 header

items.title: HubSpot Agent Hub and Agent Builder enter public beta
key_facts: Agent Hub: centralized multi-agent management with shared CRM context
Agent Builder: natural language agent creation, no-code
Available: Professional and Enterprise tiers
Shared context includes deal history, contacts, call transcripts
caveats: Agent execution limits per tier not disclosed

items.title: Kimi K3 open weights: 2.8T MoE, July 27 release commitment
key_facts: 2.8 trillion total parameters, mixture-of-experts
~1.4TB full-precision weight file
50B parameters active per token
API available since July 16

Requires NVIDIA Blackwell or AMD MI400
License: TBD

items.title: MCP 2026-07-28 spec: stateless core, three deprecations, Extensions
key_facts: Stateless core: removes session handshake and Mcp-Session-Id header
Deprecations (12-month window): Roots, Sampling, Logging
New extensions: MCP Apps, MCP Tasks
Six OAuth 2.0/OIDC security enhancements
10-week SDK validation window
caveats: Spec ships July 28 — two days after bulletin
Breaking changes possible for servers depending on Mcp-Session-Id

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.219: Opus 5 default, /fork backgrounds sessions
key_facts: Default model: Opus 5 with 1M context
/fork now creates background session (own row in claude agents)
/subtask new command for inline blocking subagent
Dynamic workflows: medium size guideline default
caveats: /fork behavior change may affect scripts depending on inline subagent execution

items.title: Anthropic expands Claude voice mode with model choice and 10-language beta
